_comment: auto-merge.py (local mode) never merges a branch that changes these paths: a person reviews them. Home defaults, a repo can only add more ("auto_merge_hold" in .claude/quality-gates.json, read from the base commit). guard-paths style: "dir/" is a prefix, * and ? are globs, else the exact path or a directory prefix. Why each: .claude/ and .mcp.json hold the hooks, permissions and tools agents run under; CI files run code on push; dependency manifests and lock files pull new code from the internet (supply chain).
